title: T-source characters withdrawn from the CJK D candidate
scope: The 6,545 T-source characters that IRGN1306 asks to withdraw from the CJK D candidate, one record per row. Each record keeps the C1_V20 working number as its serial, the printed row number as its sequence and the T source printed beside it. C1_V20 is a working number, and no published Unicode scalar is claimed for any row. Two rows repeat one working number and two pairs repeat a source, as printed.

documents.title: Request to Withdraw 6545 T-Source from CJK D candidate
documents.status: Asks the IRG to withdraw 6,545 T sources from the CJK D candidate, leaving 1,614. The cover prints “IRG N 1306” and the attachment headers “IRGN 1306 Attachment”; rows print only a row number, C1_V20 and a T source, with no glyph column. The cover says the attachment has 62 pages while its attachment pages run 1–61. Rows 3900 and 3901 repeat one working number and source, and TC-5229 and TD-4F5C each appear twice.
